scientific_integrity: An analytical all-dimension proof is supplied. Finite symbolic and high-precision checks support but do not replace proof. Source dates are verified as publisher public dates; no earlier public preprint was identified by targeted searches.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the specified rational GRP formula, not all possible finite-dimensional exchangeable extensions. The positive binary mixture is an explicit construction, not a uniqueness theorem. The original mixed density and its sufficient domain are prior work; a generic bivariate separable-copula result and generic multivariate FGM criteria may imply special steps. Historical priority is qualified; no independent validation.
title: Sharp dimension-dependent admissibility and exchangeability transition for generalized ratio-polynomial copulas
